youtube.title: What If You Respawned at a Random Spot on Earth? #Shorts
youtube.description:
What if you respawned at a random spot on Earth, like a GTA 6 character with no hospital and no safe house? Remy spins the globe four times.

Respawn 1: water. About 71% of Earth's surface is ocean, so most of the time you'd appear far from any shore.
Respawn 2: land. Only about 29% of the planet is land.
About a third of that land is desert.
Respawn 3: ice. Roughly a tenth of all land is covered by glaciers and ice sheets, mostly in Antarctica and Greenland.
Respawn 4: a city. Cities and towns cover only a few percent of the land (roughly 1-3%).
Put it together: 0.29 x 0.03 = 0.009, so landing in a city is less than one chance in a hundred.

In the game you respawn somewhere safe. On the real Earth, you'd mostly respawn in the sea. Where do you think you'd land first?

Sources:
- Earth's surface about 71% water, 29% land: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Land
- Deserts about a third of land (depends on the definition): https://www.universetoday.com/65639/what-percentage-of-the-earths-land-surface-is-desert/
- Glaciers and ice sheets about 10% of land, mostly Antarctica and Greenland: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Land , https://nsidc.org/learn/parts-cryosphere/glaciers
- Urban / built-up land about 1-3% of land: https://rock.geosociety.org/gsatoday/archive/22/12/table/i1052-5173-22-12-4-T01.pdf

The globe in the video is stylised (approximate continents), not a real map.
Remy is fictional. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two. No game footage, art or logos are used.
